KEY IMPROVEMENTS
----------------

1. ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW (Simplified)
   - Replaced verbose diagrams with quick reference map
   - Emphasized key discoveries: lazy loading, WebSocket rooms, singletons

2. CRITICAL PATTERNS (Enhanced)
   Five core patterns documented with discovery context:
   - Pattern 1: Env Initialization (import order is CRITICAL)
   - Pattern 2: Lazy Model Loading (30s→3s startup improvement)
   - Pattern 3: GPU Memory Management (try-finally with cleanup)
   - Pattern 4: WebSocket Real-Time Progress (7 weighted stages)
   - Pattern 5: Graceful Fallback (GPU→CPU fallback path)

3. CORE MODULE DISCOVERY MAP (New Detail)
   Added specific discoveries for 9 key modules:
   - hunyuan_integration.py: Thread-safe singleton, lazy load models
   - websocket_manager.py: Job rooms via Socket.IO subscription
   - progress_tracker.py: 7 weighted stages, 100-sample ETA history
   - gpu_manager.py: VRAM pre-check before jobs
   - Each with file/line references for quick location

4. FRONTEND STRUCTURE (Added)
   - Documented monolithic HTML frontend (orfeas-ai-studio.html)
   - Socket.IO client integration patterns
   - Section navigation using showSection() pattern

5. API ENDPOINTS (Discovery Format)
   - Return types and parameters documented
   - WebSocket events clearly listed
   - Alternative polling endpoint noted

6. DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW (Enhanced)
   - Added WebSocket test commands
   - Critical import order checking noted
   - Backend initialization prerequisite emphasized

7. COMMON ISSUES & SOLUTIONS (Enhanced)
   - 8 real issues with specific file locations
   - Root causes explained
   - Line ranges provided for each fix

8. DISCOVERY-BASED INSIGHTS (NEW SECTION)
   Six unique architectural patterns:
   - Async-Without-Queues: In-memory tracking, not Redis
   - Lazy Loading Over Preloading: Startup speed vs. performance
   - Thread-Safe Singletons: Consistent service initialization
   - WebSocket Rooms: Lightweight subscriptions, scales to 1000s
   - Graceful Degradation: CPU fallback for all GPU operations
   - Weighted Progress: Non-linear progress calculation
